name: Leticia la mew Symphonia
original_name: レティシア・ラ・ミュウ・シンフォニア
source: Leticia is the princess of Symphonia. Cliff rescues her by accident when she flees from her guards. She starts to work at the pub Korogaru Ringotei. She gives the false name Leticia Apple when she meets someone who doesn't know she is a princess.
